title: Connect a distributed worker
summary: Connect another trusted machine as a scoped worker while keeping verification and integration authority on the coordinator.

steps.title: Review the distributed trust boundary
steps.detail: Remote workers receive scoped work and submit proposals; the Station retains checks and approval authority.

steps.title: Secure network reachability
steps.detail: Use TLS through an approved reverse proxy or an SSH tunnel. Do not expose the default local Station directly.

steps.title: Enable runner access
steps.detail: Use Diagnostics to enable/rotate worker access and copy the token directly to the trusted worker host.

steps.title: Claim a scoped task
steps.detail: Start the bundled worker client and verify that the coordinator, not the worker, performs verification and integration.
